name: AuditLogs
description: Audit log for Azure Active Directory. Includes system activity information about user and group management, managed applications, and directory activities. Ref: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/reference/tables/auditlogs

fields.name: TimeGenerated
fields.description: Date and time the record was created. Raw: TimeGenerated (datetime). Conversion: datetime → INT64 epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: _Size
fields.description: Internal record size in bytes, used for ingestion accounting. Not sourced from AuditLogs.

fields.name: AADOperationType
fields.description: Type of the operation. Possible values are Add, Update, Delete, and Other. Raw: AADOperationType (string).

fields.name: AADTenantId
fields.description: ID of the AAD tenant. Raw: AADTenantId (string).

fields.name: ActivityDateTime
fields.description: Date and time the activity was performed in UTC. Raw: ActivityDateTime (datetime). Conversion: datetime → INT64 epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: ActivityDisplayName
fields.description: Activity name or the operation name (e.g. Create User, Add member to group). See the Azure AD activity list for the full set. Raw: ActivityDisplayName (string).

fields.name: AdditionalDetails
fields.description: Additional details on the activity. Raw: AdditionalDetails (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint; KQL queries can access JSON fields directly.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Log category. Currently 'Audit' is the only supported value. Raw: Category (string).

fields.name: CorrelationId
fields.description: Optional GUID that's passed by the client. Helps correlate client-side operations with server-side operations and is useful when tracking logs that span services. Raw: CorrelationId (string).

fields.name: DurationMs
fields.description: Property is not used and can be ignored. Raw: DurationMs (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: GUID that uniquely identifies the activity. Raw: Id (string).

fields.name: Identity
fields.description: Identity from the token that was presented when the request was made. The identity can be a user account, system account, or service principal. Raw: Identity (string).

fields.name: InitiatedBy
fields.description: User or app that initiated the activity. Raw: InitiatedBy (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Message type. Currently always 'Informational'. Raw: Level (string).

fields.name: Location
fields.description: Location of the datacenter. Raw: Location (string).

fields.name: LoggedByService
fields.description: Service that initiated the activity (e.g. Self-service Password Management, Core Directory, B2C, Invited Users, Microsoft Identity Manager, Privileged Identity Management). Raw: LoggedByService (string).

fields.name: OperationName
fields.description: Name of the operation. Raw: OperationName (string).

fields.name: OperationVersion
fields.description: REST API version requested by the client. Raw: OperationVersion (string).

fields.name: Resource
fields.description: Raw: Resource (string).

fields.name: ResourceGroup
fields.description: Raw: ResourceGroup (string).

fields.name: ResourceId
fields.description: Raw: ResourceId (string).

fields.name: ResourceProvider
fields.description: Raw: ResourceProvider (string).

fields.name: Result
fields.description: Result of the activity. Possible values: success, failure, timeout, unknownFutureValue. Raw: Result (string).

fields.name: ResultDescription
fields.description: Additional description of the result. Raw: ResultDescription (string).

fields.name: ResultReason
fields.description: Describes cause of failure or timeout results. Raw: ResultReason (string).

fields.name: ResultSignature
fields.description: Property is not used and can be ignored. Raw: ResultSignature (string).

fields.name: ResultType
fields.description: Result of the operation. Possible values are Success and Failure. Raw: ResultType (string).

fields.name: SourceSystem
fields.description: The type of agent the event was collected by (e.g. OpsManager for Windows agents, Linux for Linux agents, Azure for Azure Diagnostics). Raw: SourceSystem (string).

fields.name: TargetResources
fields.description: Information on which resource was changed due to the activity. Target Resource Type can be User, Device, Directory, App, Role, Group, Policy, or Other. Raw: TargetResources (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The name of the table. Raw: Type (string).
